title: THE WORLD
kicker: THE WORLD IN ONE DAY  ·  50 STORIES  ·  8 REGIONS  ·  15 FIELDS  ·  EVERY ONE FROM TUESDAY 24 NOVEMBER 2026
subhead: Huang is back at Nvidia · The Hague calls Myanmar's Rohingya campaign genocide · Iran hits Gulf sites and sues for $290bn

leads.head: Huang is back: Nvidia board reinstates its chief
leads.deck: Unanimous vote, 11 days after he resigned over affairs — one with a woman US authorities suspect of spying for China. Shares +31.5% to $165.05.

leads.head: Genocide, the world court rules, in Myanmar
leads.deck: The court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya — its landmark verdict on the 2017 campaign.

leads.head: Iran hits Gulf sites, sues for $290bn
leads.deck: Tehran steps up attacks on US bases and civilian sites in the Gulf, and sues for $290bn, as a US blockade and sanctions squeeze it.

minis.head: US blacklists Megaspeed
minis.deck: Commerce puts the Singapore chip firm on its trade blacklist.

minis.head: Russian jets in Korea's air zone
minis.deck: Russian warplanes enter Korea's air zone; alert for Ulleung Island.

minis.head: 22nd sanctions package
minis.deck: EU proposes 22nd package: Russian teams banned; banks, crypto hit.

minis.head: Russia warns Finland, Estonia
minis.deck: Moscow warns Finland and Estonia; Kyiv says new strikes are planned.

minis.head: Strikes kill three, incl. UN worker
minis.deck: Israeli strikes kill three in Gaza, including an UNRWA worker.

minis.head: States sue SpaceX over Grok images
minis.deck: Virginia and Oregon sue SpaceX over sexual imagery made by Grok AI.

minis.head: Waymo off the freeways
minis.deck: Waymo suspends its driverless taxis from all US freeways.

minis.head: Youngest title match opens
minis.deck: Gukesh defends against Sindarov, Game 1 in Geneva; $2.5m fund.

minis.head: India–NZ Test drawn
minis.deck: First Test ends in a draw after a strong fightback by the visitors.

minis.head: Modi opens AI centre
minis.deck: PM Modi inaugurates an AI centre at IIT Patna; Rs 400 cr park.

minis.head: Boat capsizes, dozens missing
minis.deck: A migrant boat capsizes off Senegal, leaving dozens missing.
